tale_jericho_action.description: Execute one Jericho action. The tool auto-starts the current episode on first call and auto-closes when done. Each phase is a single game attempt — no restart within a phase.

action.description: One textual action sent to the environment (a short English command, e.g. look / go north / take key / open door).

env_name.description: Target env/task name. Required on the first call of a task.

task_index.description: Task index fallback when env_name is omitted.

admissible_commands.description: Expose admissible commands in the returned info.

tale_suite_root.description: Optional absolute path to the tale-suite root.

query_wm.description: Query the current in-memory world model graph for this game session. Returns all discovered rooms, connections (action -> destination room), score changes, and untried actions per room (frontier). Use this to see where you have been, what you have tried, and what remains unexplored. No parameters needed.

wiki_memory_read.description: Search the wiki knowledge base (embedding-based semantic retrieval). Use this in Phase 2 to find relevant skills, world knowledge, and past experiences before or while solving a task.

section.description: Search scope. knowledge=tactics/recipes (use when stuck/seeking a solution), experiences=past lessons (use before high-risk moves to avoid traps). Prefer section='knowledge'. Default: 'all'.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return, default 10.

run_terminal_cmd.description: Execute a shell command. In phase_m, use it to read trajectory logs (one call with cat) and write wiki files (heredoc: cat << 'WIKI_EOF' > PATH ... WIKI_EOF, mkdir -p for directories). Do NOT use python3 -c for file writes.
